parent_context:

Option C — Web science
7. Alexia and Jay are discussing their use of online resources to prepare for their IB examinations. 
They often visit websites such as BBC Bitesize.
Alexia refers to accessing the websites as “surfing the internet” and Jay refers to the 
resources as being “on the web”.
(a) Distinguish between the internet and the World Wide Web. [2]
The uniform resource locator (URL) for the BBC Bitesize website is as follows:
https://www.bbc.co.uk/bytesize/index.htm
(b) Identify two characteristics of a URL. [2]
Jay wants to transfer a file to Alexia and suggests they use file transfer protocol (FTP).
(c) Identify two characteristics of file transfer protocol. [2]
(d) Explain how a web browser functions. [3]
(Option C continues on the following page)
